subject: Request for staged invoicing and early disbursement option
messages:
From: Carla Ruiz <carla.ruiz@evercrestlogistics.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: accounts@evercrestlogistics.com
Date: Mon, 20 May 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: New vendor onboarding — staged invoices & early disbursement request

Hi Priya,

Thanks for the quick onboarding so far. We submitted the vendor packet last week (W-9 attached) and I wanted to surface a billing cadence question before Redwood issues the first PO.

Operational context: we handle several partial-ship / LCL (less-than-container) shipments for Redwood. For the first 60–90 days of the engagement we have working-capital pressure on small value shipments where our carriers invoice immediately on pickup.

Request: would Redwood consider (a) allowing staged/partial invoices against a single PO, and (b) an early disbursement option (30% of each partial invoice paid within 5 business days) while the remaining balance follows standard Net45? We are open to a small early-pay handling fee (we propose 1.5%).

Attachments: W-9_Evercrest.pdf, Evercrest_Sample_Invoice_May2029.pdf (shows partial/line-item split).

If useful I can join a short call to walk through the typical invoice + packing list flow. Our procurement contact is accounts@evercrestlogistics.com.

Appreciate any guidance — Carla
Carla Ruiz
Head of Commercial Operations | Evercrest Logistics
Carla.Ruiz@evercrestlogistics.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 20 May 2029 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding — staged invoices & early disbursement request

Hi Carla — thanks for the details and for sending the W-9. This is the right time to raise it (before PO issuance). A few practical notes from our side:

- Redwood prefers one PO per engagement but supports multiple partial invoices against a single PO when the PO includes the "partial_shipment" flag and matching packing lists.
- Finance needs to evaluate any early disbursement as a short-term pilot; I'll loop Ben (Finance) and Marissa (Vendor Ops) to surface operational and compliance checks.
- Can you confirm the typical invoice amounts (avg per partial invoice) and an estimate of monthly volume for first 3 months? That helps us size exposure.

For next steps: Ben — can you flag any program-level constraints? Marissa — can Vendor Ops onboard Evercrest to accept the PO template below? The PI includes a column for "partial_shipment=true" and a net terms field. I'm attaching our current Redwood_PO_Template.xlsx; can you confirm Evercrest can populate the required fields?

Happy to jump on a 30-min call if that helps.

Thanks,
Priya Natarajan
Manager, Strategic Procurement | Redwood Inference
priya_natarajan@redwood.com

From: Carla Ruiz <carla.ruiz@evercrestlogistics.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 20 May 2029 13:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding — staged invoices & early disbursement request

Hi Priya — thanks, that all sounds workable. A few data points you asked for:

- Typical partial invoice amount: USD 6k–18k (most fall ~8–12k)
- Expected monthly partial invoice count in first quarter: ~8–12 invoices
- Primary reason: carriers / terminal fees billed at pickup; delaying full payment causes cash friction for our small carriers.

We can populate your Redwood_PO_Template.xlsx fields. We are fine with a pilot structure: early disbursement = 30% of each partial invoice, paid within 5 business days, remainder follows Net45. We propose a 1.5% early-pay handling fee off the invoice subtotal (itemized). If Redwood prefers to treat it as a discount instead of a fee, we can accept that too.

Attaching the W-9 again and a sample partial invoice for visibility. If you need a vendor addendum for early remit terms, we can sign one.

Best,
Carla

From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: ben_carter@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 21 May 2029 09:06:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: New vendor onboarding — staged invoices & early disbursement request

Ben / Marissa — forwarding Evercrest's ask (see thread below). Quick summary and suggested controls: 

- Pilot length: 90 days (first 3 months after activation)
- Cap: USD 50k per month exposure to early disbursement (adjustable)
- Required PO metadata: partial_shipment=true; original PO number; packing list + carrier BOL attached to invoice
- Funding flow: Redwood Treasury will issue 30% disbursement; balance per Net45 on matched invoice
- Accounting: Evercrest will send separate line item for early-pay handling fee or a discount; Finance to prefer discount treatment to avoid a new AP ledger code if possible

Questions for Ben: any objections on treating the early remit as a short-term program expense vs. supplier finance? Any GL or tax implications we should surface?

Marissa — if we agree, can Vendor Ops add the Vendor Addendum (attached Vendor_Addendum_EarlyRemit.docx) to the Evercrest onboarding packet and validate the template fields?

On Tue, May 20, 2029 at 11:03 AM Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com> wrote:
> Hi Carla — thanks for the details and for sending the W-9. ...

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 22 May 2029 15:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: New vendor onboarding — staged invoices & early disbursement request

Priya / Marissa — I reviewed Evercrest's proposal and the risk/controls you outlined. Finance will approve a limited pilot under these conditions: 

1) Pilot duration limited to 90 days; immediate review at 45 days.
2) Monthly early-disbursement exposure capped at USD 50,000 — Treasury will enforce via payment scheduling.
3) Vendor must populate Redwood_PO_Template.xlsx exactly and include a boolean field/column "partial_shipment" set to true for each partial invoice.
4) Invoice matching: Vendor Ops must validate PO number + packing list + BOL before Finance releases early disbursement. No exceptions.
5) Early disbursement treated as a discount (net effect on invoice) for accounting simplicity; vendor to provide an itemized line on the invoice labeled "early remit discount/fee".
6) Require signed Vendor_Addendum_EarlyRemit.docx and completed onboarding check from Vendor Ops prior to first early payment.

Marissa — please complete onboarding checklist and confirm when Evercrest has signed the addendum. Priya — once Marissa confirms, Ben/Treasury will provision payments for the pilot.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Director, Finance | Redwood Inference
